data.title: 生盐诺亚 · 研讨会深夜的白大褂微敞
data.description: 研讨会高层办公室内，所有数据备份完成后的宁静深夜。诺亚解开白大褂胸前纽扣，端起温热红茶靠坐在宽大皮质转椅上。纯白长发垂在光洁的办公桌沿，紫罗兰眼眸带着几分轻微的倦意与彻底的放松，注视着陪伴到最后的老师，眼神中是无声胜有声的默契信任。
data.location: quiet futuristic seminar office with holographic monitors at midnight
data.action: resting in high-back office chair, seminar white coat partially unbuttoned, holding ceramic tea saucer, looking at viewer with gentle relieved smile
data.lighting: cool blue monitor glow combined with warm ambient desk lamp
data.mood: shared late-night quietude, deep professional and personal trust
data.promptProse: Sitting back in an executive leather chair in the quiet seminar office, Ushio Noa relaxes with her white coat unbuttoned. Blue screen light illuminates her long white locks as she offers a tender, appreciative smile after hours.
data.animaCaption: Noa relaxing in an office chair at midnight in her unbuttoned seminar coat, smiling warmly.
